# Claim register

Every line of the current documents (README, CLAUDE.md, BUILD_LOG and `docs/*.md` except `docs/archive/`) that carries a
number, with the evidence and a status: **verified** (re-derived or matched to a generated file), **corrected** (wrong or
stale and fixed in this audit), **historical** (stage-labelled analysis of an earlier state, not re-derived), **stale** /
**wrong** (none left open) or **unverifiable** (a presenter note, not a data claim). Generated by the audit script from the
documents as they stood at the end of the audit (2026-10-18); numbers are checked against `reports/RESULTS.md`, `config.py`,
`rules/seller_rules.yaml` and an independent recomputation from the raw files.

Summary: corrected 3, historical 221, unverifiable 1, verified 543 (768 lines).

## Corrections made in this audit

| Where | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `sql/schema.sql` view `vw_SellerScorecard` | `items_sold` came from the 5+ items pool: NULL for 1,231 of 3,095 sellers | counts every seller's items from `FactOrderItems` (0 for 125); view reloaded; owner-approved Tier 2 |
| `docs/MANUAL_CHECKS.md` query 3 | 1,149 reasons with an em dash | 1,155 (SQL and CSV agree) |
| `docs/powerbi_setup.md` | first blank weight at row 8,578 | data row 8,579 |
| `docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md` questions 1 and 10 | saved forest 424 MB before tuning | 421 MB (RESULTS.md leaf table) |
| `docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md` question 8 | Warn and Suspend need 5 items sold | 5 items sold and 3 delivered (or reviewed) orders |
| `docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md` question 2 | a SYNTHETIC tag | the "Synthetic data" tag the pages show |
| `README.md` | Makefile targets without `load-sql` | `load-sql` listed; attribution and synthetic-data paragraph added |
| `CLAUDE.md` section 1 and 11 | "no date column" as a feature | no delivered/estimated date, delivery days, review or target; purchase month and weekday are allowed (they are features) |
| `CLAUDE.md` 7.4, 1, 11 | gate = 5 items sold | adds the owner-approved order gates and `n_orders`, `n_reviewed` facts |
| Intelligence tooltip, `reports/RESULTS.md` | review 4.14 described as "per reviewed order"; 4.16 not shown | names the seller-order definition and gives 4.14 / 4.16 / 4.08 |
| Intelligence tooltip | "About 0.75% of items have no review" typed | computed from the fact table |
| Implementation page | `1 items sold`; crash on a seller whose counts are missing | `1 item sold`; missing counts show a dash |
